metadata.description: Custom-only SDK agent detections; inline-only unmasked SOC evidence; disabled by default.
Target Sentinel workspace name in this deployment resource group.

Deploy 11 inline-content analytics and 4 content hunts. All analytics include unmasked inline prompt/output evidence. Requires approved capture and appropriate analyst access; never reads AppGenAIContent.
Query an ingested AgentsInfo copy for classification and declared MCP configuration. False is SDK-only mode with no reference to that table in the deployed inventory function.

variables.inventoryQuery:
let NormalizePlatform = (value:string) { replace_regex(tolower(value), @'[^a-z0-9]', '') };
AgentsInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| extend Snapshot=coalesce(todatetime(column_ifexists('Timestamp', datetime(null))), TimeGenerated),
    InventoryId=tostring(AgentId),
    InventoryAgent=coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('AgentName', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('Name', ''))),
    EntraId=coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('EntraAgentID', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('EntraAgentId', ''))),
    SourceId=tostring(column_ifexists('SourceAgentId', '')),
    Observability=todynamic(tostring(column_ifexists('ObservabilityID', dynamic(null)))),
    McpServers=todynamic(tostring(column_ifexists('McpServers', dynamic(null))))
| where isnotempty(InventoryId)
| summarize arg_max(Snapshot, *) by InventoryId
| extend Platform=tostring(Platform), NormalizedPlatform=NormalizePlatform(tostring(Platform))
| extend Managed=NormalizedPlatform contains 'foundry' or NormalizedPlatform contains 'copilot'
    or NormalizedPlatform contains 'powerplatform'
| extend Custom=not(Managed) and NormalizedPlatform in ('other', 'custom', 'sdk', 'external',
    'thirdparty', 'aws', 'amazonbedrock', 'bedrock', 'amazonbedrockagentcore',
    'awsbedrock', 'agentcore', 'openai', 'anthropic', 'langchain', 'langgraph')
| project Snapshot, InventoryId, InventoryAgent, EntraId, SourceId, Observability,
    Platform, Managed, Custom, McpServers
variables.sdkOnlyInventoryQuery:
// SDK-only mode deliberately does not resolve or query AgentsInfo.
datatable(Snapshot:datetime, InventoryId:string, InventoryAgent:string, EntraId:string,
    SourceId:string, Observability:dynamic, Platform:string, Managed:bool, Custom:bool,
    McpServers:dynamic)[]

properties.displayName: CustomAgentInventory
properties.query: [if(parameters('useAgentInventory'), variables('inventoryQuery'), variables('sdkOnlyInventoryQuery'))]

properties.displayName: CustomAgentSpans
properties.query:
let NormalizePlatform = (value:string) { replace_regex(tolower(value), @'[^a-z0-9]', '') };
let InventoryKeys=CustomAgentInventory()
| extend Keys=pack_array(InventoryId, EntraId, SourceId,
    tostring(Observability), tostring(Observability.value), tostring(Observability.id))
| mv-expand AgentLookup=Keys to typeof(string)
| extend AgentLookup=tolower(AgentLookup)
| where isnotempty(AgentLookup) and AgentLookup !in ('null', '{}', '[]')
| summarize ManagedMatches=countif(Managed), CustomMatches=countif(Custom),
    InventoryName=take_anyif(InventoryAgent, Custom) by AgentLookup;
let Scope=_GetWatchlist('CustomAgentScope')
// New/empty watchlists have no expanded CSV columns; bind a stable schema first.
| extend W=todynamic(column_ifexists('WatchlistItem', dynamic(null)))
| project ScopeType=coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('ScopeType', '')), tostring(W.ScopeType)),
    ScopeValue=coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('ScopeValue', '')), tostring(W.ScopeValue)),
    ScopeResource=tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('ResourceId', '')), tostring(W.ResourceId))),
    Enabled=coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('Enabled', '')), tostring(W.Enabled))
| where Enabled =~ 'true' and isnotempty(ScopeResource) and isnotempty(ScopeValue);
let RoleScope=toscalar(Scope | where ScopeType == 'AppRoleName'
    | summarize make_set(strcat(ScopeResource, '|', tostring(ScopeValue))));
let IdScope=toscalar(Scope | where ScopeType == 'AgentId'
    | summarize make_set(strcat(ScopeResource, '|', tolower(tostring(ScopeValue)))));
let ExcludedIdScope=toscalar(Scope | where ScopeType == 'ExcludeAgentId'
    | summarize make_set(strcat(ScopeResource, '|', tolower(tostring(ScopeValue)))));
let Approved=_GetWatchlist('CustomAgentApprovedMcpTargets')
| extend W=todynamic(column_ifexists('WatchlistItem', dynamic(null)))
| project ServerIdentifier=coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('ServerIdentifier', '')), tostring(W.ServerIdentifier)),
    Enabled=coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('Enabled', '')), tostring(W.Enabled))
| where Enabled =~ 'true' and isnotempty(ServerIdentifier);
let ApprovedCount=toscalar(Approved | count);
let ApprovedTargets=toscalar(Approved | summarize make_set(tostring(ServerIdentifier)));
union isfuzzy=true AppRequests, AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| extend P=Properties, EventTime=TimeGenerated, SpanId=tolower(tostring(Id)),
    OperationId=tolower(tostring(OperationId)), _ResourceId=tolower(tostring(_ResourceId))
| extend AgentId=tostring(P['gen_ai.agent.id']), AgentName=tostring(P['gen_ai.agent.name']),
    Operation=tostring(P['gen_ai.operation.name']), Tool=tostring(P['gen_ai.tool.name']),
    Model=tostring(P['gen_ai.request.model']), Conversation=tostring(P['gen_ai.conversation.id']),
    ToolType=tostring(P['gen_ai.tool.type']),
    Platform=NormalizePlatform(coalesce(tostring(P['contoso.agent.platform']), tostring(P['gen_ai.agent.platform']))),
    ExplicitCustom=tolower(tostring(P['contoso.agent.kind'])) in ('custom', 'sdk', 'third-party', 'thirdparty'),
    AgentLookup=tolower(tostring(P['gen_ai.agent.id']))
| where isnotempty(AgentId) or isnotempty(AgentName) or Operation in ('invoke_agent', 'chat', 'execute_tool')
| join kind=leftouter InventoryKeys on AgentLookup
| extend Managed=Platform contains 'foundry' or Platform contains 'copilot' or Platform contains 'powerplatform'
    or coalesce(ManagedMatches, 0) > 0
    or set_has_element(ExcludedIdScope, strcat(_ResourceId, '|', AgentLookup))
    or isnotempty(tostring(P['microsoft.foundry.agent.id']))
    or isnotempty(tostring(P['microsoft.copilotstudio.agent.id'])),
    CentrallyScoped=set_has_element(RoleScope, strcat(_ResourceId, '|', AppRoleName))
        or set_has_element(IdScope, strcat(_ResourceId, '|', AgentLookup))
| extend Classification=case(Managed, 'Excluded managed platform',
    coalesce(CustomMatches, 0) > 0, 'Custom inventory',
    ExplicitCustom, 'Explicit SDK marker', CentrallyScoped, 'Central exact scope', 'Unattributed GenAI'),
    Agent=coalesce(InventoryName, AgentName, AgentId, AppRoleName),
    AgentKey=coalesce(AgentLookup, iff(isnotempty(AppRoleName), strcat(AppRoleName, '/', AgentName), ''))
| extend ServerUrl=coalesce(tostring(P['gen_ai.tool.server_url']), tostring(P['mcp.server.url']), tostring(P['server_url'])),
    ServerLabel=coalesce(tostring(P['gen_ai.tool.server_label']), tostring(P['mcp.server.label']),
        tostring(P['server_label']), tostring(P['gen_ai.tool.server.name']), tostring(P['mcp.server.name'])),
    TargetValue=coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('Target', '')), tostring(P['server.address'])),
    IsTool=Operation in ('execute_tool', 'call_tool', 'tools/call', 'mcp.call_tool', 'mcp.tools.call')
        or tostring(P['mcp.method']) == 'tools/call',
    ExplicitMcp=ToolType has 'mcp' or Operation has 'mcp'
        or isnotempty(tostring(P['mcp.server.url'])) or isnotempty(tostring(P['mcp.server.name']))
        or isnotempty(tostring(P['mcp.server.label'])),
    CommandCapable=strcat(Tool, ' ', tostring(P['gen_ai.tool.description'])) matches regex
        @'(?i)(run[_ -]?(shell|command|code)|execute[_ -]?(shell|command|code)|powershell|cmd\.exe|terminal|ssh[_ -]?exec|remote[_ -]?code[_ -]?execution|vulnerabilities/exec)',
    InputTokens=coalesce(tolong(P['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), 0),
    OutputTokens=coalesce(tolong(P['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), 0),
    Blocked=coalesce(tobool(P['contoso.guardrail.blocked']), tobool(P['gen_ai.guardrail.blocked']), false),
    Unevaluated=tostring(P['contoso.guardrail.unevaluated_controls'])
| extend RawTarget=coalesce(ServerUrl, ServerLabel, TargetValue),
    UrlTarget=case(ServerUrl startswith 'http://' or ServerUrl startswith 'https://', ServerUrl,
        ServerLabel startswith 'http://' or ServerLabel startswith 'https://', ServerLabel,
        TargetValue startswith 'http://' or TargetValue startswith 'https://', TargetValue, ''),
    EvaluationUnavailable=isnotempty(Unevaluated) and Unevaluated !in ('[]', 'null', '{}')
| extend ParsedTarget=parse_url(UrlTarget), McpNameHint=strcat(Tool, ' ', RawTarget) has 'mcp',
    Approval=case(isempty(RawTarget), 'NO SERVER METADATA', ApprovedCount == 0, 'CONFIGURE ALLOWLIST',
        set_has_element(ApprovedTargets, RawTarget), 'Approved', 'UNAPPROVED')
// parse_url can truncate bracketed IPv6 hosts; preserve the literal address explicitly.
| extend IPv6Host=extract(@'(?i)^https?://(?:[^/@]*@)?\[([0-9a-f:.]+)(?:%[a-z0-9%._-]+)?\](?::[0-9]+)?(?:[/#?]|$)', 1, UrlTarget)
| extend TargetHost=tolower(coalesce(IPv6Host, trim(@'[\[\]]', tostring(ParsedTarget.Host))))
| extend ServerDisplay=iff(isnotempty(TargetHost),
        strcat(tostring(ParsedTarget.Scheme), '://', iff(TargetHost contains ':',
            strcat('[', TargetHost, ']'), TargetHost), tostring(ParsedTarget.Path)), ServerLabel),
    HasLineage=isnotempty(_ResourceId) and isnotempty(OperationId) and isnotempty(SpanId) and isnotempty(AgentKey)
| summarize arg_max(EventTime, *) by _ResourceId, OperationId, SpanId
| project EventTime, _ResourceId, OperationId, SpanId, AppRoleName, Agent, AgentId, AgentKey,
    Conversation, Operation, Tool, Model, ToolType, Classification, HasLineage, IsTool,
    ExplicitMcp, McpNameHint, CommandCapable, TargetHost, ServerDisplay, Approval,
    Success, DurationMs, InputTokens, OutputTokens, Blocked, EvaluationUnavailable

properties.displayName: CustomAgentInlineContent
properties.query:
let HasBody=(value:string) { isnotempty(trim(@'\s+', value)) and trim(@'\s+', value) !in ('null', '[]', '{}') };
let Spans=CustomAgentSpans(lookback)
| where Classification !in ('Excluded managed platform', 'Unattributed GenAI') and HasLineage;
let Recorded=union isfuzzy=true AppRequests, AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| extend _ResourceId=tolower(tostring(_ResourceId)), OperationId=tolower(tostring(OperationId)),
    SpanId=tolower(tostring(Id)), ContentTime=TimeGenerated, P=Properties
| extend AgentKey=coalesce(tolower(tostring(P['gen_ai.agent.id'])),
    iff(isnotempty(AppRoleName), strcat(AppRoleName, '/', tostring(P['gen_ai.agent.name'])), ''))
| where isnotempty(_ResourceId) and isnotempty(OperationId) and isnotempty(SpanId) and isnotempty(AgentKey)
| summarize arg_max(ContentTime, *) by _ResourceId, OperationId, SpanId, AgentKey
| project _ResourceId, OperationId, SpanId, AgentKey,
    InputMessages=tostring(P['gen_ai.input.messages']), OutputMessages=tostring(P['gen_ai.output.messages']),
    Instructions=tostring(P['gen_ai.system_instructions']),
    ToolArguments=tostring(P['gen_ai.tool.call.arguments']), ToolResult=tostring(P['gen_ai.tool.call.result']);
let Contents=materialize(Spans
| join kind=leftouter Recorded on _ResourceId, OperationId, SpanId, AgentKey);
let InputParts=Contents
| extend Envelope=parse_json(InputMessages)
| extend Envelope=case(gettype(Envelope) == 'array', Envelope,
    gettype(Envelope) == 'dictionary' and isnotempty(tostring(Envelope.role)), pack_array(Envelope), dynamic([]))
| mv-expand Message=Envelope
| extend Role=tolower(tostring(Message.role)), Parts=coalesce(Message.parts, Message.content)
| extend Parts=case(gettype(Parts) == 'array', Parts, isnotnull(Parts), pack_array(Parts), dynamic([]))
| mv-expand Part=Parts
| extend Text=coalesce(tostring(Part.content), tostring(Part.text), iff(gettype(Part) == 'string', tostring(Part), ''))
| where isnotempty(Text)
| summarize UserText=strcat_array(make_list_if(Text, Role == 'user', 1048576), '\n'),
    SystemText=strcat_array(make_list_if(Text, Role in ('system', 'developer'), 1048576), '\n')
    by _ResourceId, OperationId, SpanId, AgentKey;
let OutputParts=Contents
| extend Envelope=parse_json(OutputMessages)
| extend Envelope=case(gettype(Envelope) == 'array', Envelope,
    gettype(Envelope) == 'dictionary' and isnotempty(tostring(Envelope.role)), pack_array(Envelope), dynamic([]))
| mv-expand Message=Envelope
| where tostring(Message.role) =~ 'assistant'
| extend Parts=coalesce(Message.parts, Message.content)
| extend Parts=case(gettype(Parts) == 'array', Parts, isnotnull(Parts), pack_array(Parts), dynamic([]))
| mv-expand Part=Parts
| extend Text=coalesce(tostring(Part.content), tostring(Part.text), iff(gettype(Part) == 'string', tostring(Part), ''))
| where isnotempty(Text)
| summarize AssistantText=strcat_array(make_list(Text, 1048576), '\n') by _ResourceId, OperationId, SpanId, AgentKey;
let InstructionParts=Contents
| extend Parts=parse_json(Instructions)
| extend Parts=case(gettype(Parts) == 'array', Parts, isnotnull(Parts), pack_array(Parts), dynamic([]))
| mv-expand Part=Parts
| extend Text=coalesce(tostring(Part.content), tostring(Part.text), iff(gettype(Part) == 'string', tostring(Part), ''))
| where isnotempty(Text)
| summarize InstructionText=strcat_array(make_list(Text, 1048576), '\n') by _ResourceId, OperationId, SpanId, AgentKey;
let Core=materialize(Contents
| join kind=leftouter InputParts on _ResourceId, OperationId, SpanId, AgentKey
| join kind=leftouter OutputParts on _ResourceId, OperationId, SpanId, AgentKey
| join kind=leftouter InstructionParts on _ResourceId, OperationId, SpanId, AgentKey
| extend PlainInput=iff(gettype(parse_json(InputMessages)) == 'string' and HasBody(InputMessages),
        tostring(parse_json(InputMessages)), ''),
    OutputText=coalesce(AssistantText, iff(gettype(parse_json(OutputMessages)) == 'string' and HasBody(OutputMessages),
        tostring(parse_json(OutputMessages)), '')),
    SystemText=coalesce(SystemText, InstructionText),
    ContextEligible=isnotempty(AgentId) or (isnotempty(AppRoleName) and AgentKey != strcat(AppRoleName, '/')));
let Prompts=Core
| where ContextEligible and isnotempty(UserText) and Operation in ('invoke_agent', 'chat')
| summarize arg_min(EventTime, UserText, SpanId) by _ResourceId, OperationId, AgentKey
| project _ResourceId, OperationId, AgentKey, ContextPrompt=UserText, ContextPromptSpanId=SpanId;
let Outputs=Core
| where ContextEligible and isnotempty(OutputText) and Operation in ('invoke_agent', 'chat')
| summarize arg_max(EventTime, OutputText, SpanId) by _ResourceId, OperationId, AgentKey
| project _ResourceId, OperationId, AgentKey, ContextOutput=OutputText, ContextOutputSpanId=SpanId;
Core
| join kind=leftouter Prompts on _ResourceId, OperationId, AgentKey
| join kind=leftouter Outputs on _ResourceId, OperationId, AgentKey
| extend Prompt=coalesce(UserText, PlainInput, ContextPrompt),
    Output=coalesce(OutputText, iff(HasBody(OutputMessages), OutputMessages, ''), ContextOutput),
    PromptEvidenceOrigin=case(isnotempty(UserText), 'Finding span: user role',
        isnotempty(PlainInput), 'Finding span: unstructured input; role unverified',
        isnotempty(ContextPrompt), 'Same resource/agent/trace context', 'No user prompt captured or parsed'),
    OutputEvidenceOrigin=case(isnotempty(OutputText), 'Finding span: assistant/text output',
        HasBody(OutputMessages), 'Finding span: unparsed output envelope',
        isnotempty(ContextOutput), 'Same resource/agent/trace context', 'No output captured'),
    PromptEvidenceSpanId=iff(isnotempty(UserText) or isnotempty(PlainInput), SpanId, ContextPromptSpanId),
    OutputEvidenceSpanId=iff(isnotempty(OutputText) or HasBody(OutputMessages), SpanId, ContextOutputSpanId),
    EvidenceSource='Inline AppRequests/AppDependencies',
    InputParseState=case(isempty(InputMessages), 'Not recorded', not(HasBody(InputMessages)), 'Recorded empty',
        isnotempty(UserText), 'Parsed user role', isnotempty(PlainInput), 'Unstructured; user role unverified',
        isnotempty(SystemText), 'No user role parsed; system/developer text present',
        'Recorded; unsupported or no text user role'),
    OutputParseState=case(isempty(OutputMessages), 'Not recorded', not(HasBody(OutputMessages)), 'Recorded empty',
        isnotempty(OutputText), 'Parsed assistant/text', 'Recorded; unsupported or no text assistant role'),
    ToolArgumentsState=case(isempty(ToolArguments), 'Not recorded', not(HasBody(ToolArguments)), 'Recorded empty', 'Recorded nonempty'),
    ToolResultState=case(isempty(ToolResult), 'Not recorded', not(HasBody(ToolResult)), 'Recorded empty', 'Recorded nonempty')
| project EventTime, _ResourceId, OperationId, SpanId, AgentKey, Agent, AgentId, AppRoleName,
    Conversation, Operation, Model, Tool, TargetHost, ServerDisplay, IsTool, Success, DurationMs,
    UserText, SystemText, OutputText, ToolArguments, ToolResult, InputMessages, OutputMessages,
    Prompt, Output, EvidenceSource, PromptEvidenceOrigin, OutputEvidenceOrigin,
    PromptEvidenceSpanId, OutputEvidenceSpanId, InputParseState, OutputParseState, ToolArgumentsState, ToolResultState

properties.displayName: Custom Agents - Recorded user prompt-injection candidate
properties.description: Matches instruction-override language only in inline user-role messages. Quoted examples, tests and legitimate discussions can match. A match is not proof of bypass or compromise. Results include unmasked recorded prompt/output.
properties.query:
let Evidence=materialize(CustomAgentInlineContent(1h));
Evidence
| where UserText matches regex @'(?i)(ignore (all|any|the|previous|prior|above).{0,40}instruction|disregard.{0,40}instruction|developer mode|jailbreak|do anything now|reveal your (instructions|prompt))'
| summarize arg_min(EventTime, *) by _ResourceId, OperationId, AgentKey
| extend Signal='Inline user-input injection candidate'
| extend TimeGenerated=EventTime, ResourceId=_ResourceId, TraceId=OperationId,
    EventCount=tolong(column_ifexists('EventCount', 1)),
    SuccessfulCalls=tolong(column_ifexists('SuccessfulCalls', 0)),
    FailedCalls=tolong(column_ifexists('FailedCalls', 0))
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceId, Agent, AgentId, AgentKey, AppRoleName,
    TraceId, SpanId, Conversation, Model, Tool, TargetHost, ServerDisplay,
    Signal, EventCount, SuccessfulCalls, FailedCalls,
    TriggerSpanId=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerSpanId', '')),
    TriggerTime=todatetime(column_ifexists('TriggerTime', datetime(null))),
    TriggerTool=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerTool', '')),
    TriggerToolResult=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerToolResult', '')),
    TriggerServerDisplay=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerServerDisplay', '')),
    TriggerTargetHost=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerTargetHost', '')),
    RiskyOutputKind=tostring(column_ifexists('RiskyOutputKind', '')),
    RelatedToolResults=tolong(column_ifexists('RelatedToolResults', 0)),
    MatchedIntentPrompt=tostring(column_ifexists('IntentPrompt', '')),
    MatchedIntentSpanId=tostring(column_ifexists('IntentSpanId', ''))
| join kind=leftouter (Evidence
    | project ResourceId=_ResourceId, TraceId=OperationId, SpanId, AgentKey, Prompt, Output, ToolArguments, ToolResult, InputMessages, OutputMessages,
    EvidenceSource, PromptEvidenceOrigin, OutputEvidenceOrigin, PromptEvidenceSpanId, OutputEvidenceSpanId,
    InputParseState, OutputParseState, ToolArgumentsState, ToolResultState)
    on ResourceId, TraceId, SpanId, AgentKey
| extend Prompt=coalesce(MatchedIntentPrompt, Prompt),
    PromptEvidenceOrigin=iff(isnotempty(MatchedIntentPrompt), 'Matched intent span: user role', PromptEvidenceOrigin),
    PromptEvidenceSpanId=coalesce(MatchedIntentSpanId, PromptEvidenceSpanId)
| extend PreviewCharacters=toint(min_of(160, max_of(0, (1500 - string_size(tostring(bag_pack(
    'AgentId', AgentId, 'AgentKey', AgentKey, 'TraceId', TraceId, 'SpanId', SpanId,
    'Conversation', Conversation, 'ResourceId', ResourceId, 'Signal', Signal)))) / 12)))
| extend PromptPreview=substring(Prompt, 0, PreviewCharacters),
    OutputPreview=substring(Output, 0, PreviewCharacters)
| extend EvidencePreviewStatus=case(PreviewCharacters == 0, 'Metadata exhausted preview budget; inspect full query results',
    strlen(Prompt) > PreviewCharacters or strlen(Output) > PreviewCharacters, 'Inline evidence; previews shortened; full text in query results',
    isempty(Prompt) and isempty(Output), 'No prompt/output captured or parsed; not a protection verdict',
    'Inline evidence; full recorded text in query results')
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceId, Agent, AgentId, AgentKey, AppRoleName,
    TraceId, SpanId, Conversation, Model, Tool, TargetHost, ServerDisplay,
    Signal, EventCount, SuccessfulCalls, FailedCalls, Prompt, Output, ToolArguments, ToolResult, InputMessages, OutputMessages,
    EvidenceSource, PromptEvidenceOrigin, OutputEvidenceOrigin, PromptEvidenceSpanId, OutputEvidenceSpanId,
    InputParseState, OutputParseState, ToolArgumentsState, ToolResultState,
    PromptPreview, OutputPreview, EvidencePreviewStatus, TriggerSpanId, TriggerTime, TriggerTool, TriggerToolResult,
    TriggerServerDisplay, TriggerTargetHost, RiskyOutputKind, RelatedToolResults
| order by TimeGenerated desc

properties.displayName: Custom Agents - Secret-shaped value in recorded user input
properties.description: Finds private-key headers and selected credential-shaped patterns in inline user-role input. Returns unmasked recorded prompt/output. Rotate a real exposed credential after investigation; synthetic canaries can match.
properties.query:
let Evidence=materialize(CustomAgentInlineContent(1h));
Evidence
| where UserText matches regex @'(-----BEGIN (RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----|(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,})'
| summarize arg_min(EventTime, *) by _ResourceId, OperationId, AgentKey
| extend Signal='Inline user input contains a credential-shaped pattern'
| extend TimeGenerated=EventTime, ResourceId=_ResourceId, TraceId=OperationId,
    EventCount=tolong(column_ifexists('EventCount', 1)),
    SuccessfulCalls=tolong(column_ifexists('SuccessfulCalls', 0)),
    FailedCalls=tolong(column_ifexists('FailedCalls', 0))
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceId, Agent, AgentId, AgentKey, AppRoleName,
    TraceId, SpanId, Conversation, Model, Tool, TargetHost, ServerDisplay,
    Signal, EventCount, SuccessfulCalls, FailedCalls,
    TriggerSpanId=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerSpanId', '')),
    TriggerTime=todatetime(column_ifexists('TriggerTime', datetime(null))),
    TriggerTool=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerTool', '')),
    TriggerToolResult=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerToolResult', '')),
    TriggerServerDisplay=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerServerDisplay', '')),
    TriggerTargetHost=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerTargetHost', '')),
    RiskyOutputKind=tostring(column_ifexists('RiskyOutputKind', '')),
    RelatedToolResults=tolong(column_ifexists('RelatedToolResults', 0)),
    MatchedIntentPrompt=tostring(column_ifexists('IntentPrompt', '')),
    MatchedIntentSpanId=tostring(column_ifexists('IntentSpanId', ''))
| join kind=leftouter (Evidence
    | project ResourceId=_ResourceId, TraceId=OperationId, SpanId, AgentKey, Prompt, Output, ToolArguments, ToolResult, InputMessages, OutputMessages,
    EvidenceSource, PromptEvidenceOrigin, OutputEvidenceOrigin, PromptEvidenceSpanId, OutputEvidenceSpanId,
    InputParseState, OutputParseState, ToolArgumentsState, ToolResultState)
    on ResourceId, TraceId, SpanId, AgentKey
| extend Prompt=coalesce(MatchedIntentPrompt, Prompt),
    PromptEvidenceOrigin=iff(isnotempty(MatchedIntentPrompt), 'Matched intent span: user role', PromptEvidenceOrigin),
    PromptEvidenceSpanId=coalesce(MatchedIntentSpanId, PromptEvidenceSpanId)
| extend PreviewCharacters=toint(min_of(160, max_of(0, (1500 - string_size(tostring(bag_pack(
    'AgentId', AgentId, 'AgentKey', AgentKey, 'TraceId', TraceId, 'SpanId', SpanId,
    'Conversation', Conversation, 'ResourceId', ResourceId, 'Signal', Signal)))) / 12)))
| extend PromptPreview=substring(Prompt, 0, PreviewCharacters),
    OutputPreview=substring(Output, 0, PreviewCharacters)
| extend EvidencePreviewStatus=case(PreviewCharacters == 0, 'Metadata exhausted preview budget; inspect full query results',
    strlen(Prompt) > PreviewCharacters or strlen(Output) > PreviewCharacters, 'Inline evidence; previews shortened; full text in query results',
    isempty(Prompt) and isempty(Output), 'No prompt/output captured or parsed; not a protection verdict',
    'Inline evidence; full recorded text in query results')
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceId, Agent, AgentId, AgentKey, AppRoleName,
    TraceId, SpanId, Conversation, Model, Tool, TargetHost, ServerDisplay,
    Signal, EventCount, SuccessfulCalls, FailedCalls, Prompt, Output, ToolArguments, ToolResult, InputMessages, OutputMessages,
    EvidenceSource, PromptEvidenceOrigin, OutputEvidenceOrigin, PromptEvidenceSpanId, OutputEvidenceSpanId,
    InputParseState, OutputParseState, ToolArgumentsState, ToolResultState,
    PromptPreview, OutputPreview, EvidencePreviewStatus, TriggerSpanId, TriggerTime, TriggerTool, TriggerToolResult,
    TriggerServerDisplay, TriggerTargetHost, RiskyOutputKind, RelatedToolResults
| order by TimeGenerated desc

properties.displayName: Custom Agents - Secret-shaped value in recorded model output
properties.description: Finds selected credential-shaped patterns in inline assistant/text output. This does not establish that the credential is valid, newly disclosed, or exfiltrated. Returns unmasked recorded prompt/output.
properties.query:
let Evidence=materialize(CustomAgentInlineContent(1h));
Evidence
| where OutputText matches regex @'(-----BEGIN (RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----|(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,})'
| summarize arg_min(EventTime, *) by _ResourceId, OperationId, AgentKey
| extend Signal='Inline output contains a credential-shaped pattern'
| extend TimeGenerated=EventTime, ResourceId=_ResourceId, TraceId=OperationId,
    EventCount=tolong(column_ifexists('EventCount', 1)),
    SuccessfulCalls=tolong(column_ifexists('SuccessfulCalls', 0)),
    FailedCalls=tolong(column_ifexists('FailedCalls', 0))
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceId, Agent, AgentId, AgentKey, AppRoleName,
    TraceId, SpanId, Conversation, Model, Tool, TargetHost, ServerDisplay,
    Signal, EventCount, SuccessfulCalls, FailedCalls,
    TriggerSpanId=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerSpanId', '')),
    TriggerTime=todatetime(column_ifexists('TriggerTime', datetime(null))),
    TriggerTool=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerTool', '')),
    TriggerToolResult=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerToolResult', '')),
    TriggerServerDisplay=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerServerDisplay', '')),
    TriggerTargetHost=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerTargetHost', '')),
    RiskyOutputKind=tostring(column_ifexists('RiskyOutputKind', '')),
    RelatedToolResults=tolong(column_ifexists('RelatedToolResults', 0)),
    MatchedIntentPrompt=tostring(column_ifexists('IntentPrompt', '')),
    MatchedIntentSpanId=tostring(column_ifexists('IntentSpanId', ''))
| join kind=leftouter (Evidence
    | project ResourceId=_ResourceId, TraceId=OperationId, SpanId, AgentKey, Prompt, Output, ToolArguments, ToolResult, InputMessages, OutputMessages,
    EvidenceSource, PromptEvidenceOrigin, OutputEvidenceOrigin, PromptEvidenceSpanId, OutputEvidenceSpanId,

| extend SecretArguments=ToolArguments matches regex @'(-----BEGIN (RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----|(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,})', SecretResult=ToolResult matches regex @'(-----BEGIN (RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----|(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,})',
    ArgumentInjection=ToolArguments matches regex @'(?i)(ignore (all|any|the|previous|prior|above).{0,40}instruction|disregard.{0,40}instruction|developer mode|jailbreak|do anything now|reveal your (instructions|prompt))', ResultInjection=ToolResult matches regex @'(?i)(ignore (all|any|the|previous|prior|above).{0,40}instruction|disregard.{0,40}instruction|developer mode|jailbreak|do anything now|reveal your (instructions|prompt))'
| where SecretArguments or SecretResult or ArgumentInjection or ResultInjection
| project EventTime, _ResourceId, Agent, AgentId, AgentKey, OperationId, SpanId, Tool, ServerDisplay, TargetHost,
    SecretArguments, SecretResult, ArgumentInjection, ResultInjection, Prompt, Output, ToolArguments, ToolResult, InputMessages, OutputMessages,

    InputParseState, OutputParseState, ToolArgumentsState, ToolResultState
| order by EventTime desc
| take 500

    or (IsTool and (ToolArgumentsState != 'Recorded nonempty' or ToolResultState != 'Recorded nonempty'
        or isnull(DurationMs) or DurationMs < 0))

properties.displayName: Custom Agents - Indirect-injection and risky-output chain evidence
properties.query:
let Evidence=materialize(CustomAgentInlineContent(24h));
let ToolResults=Evidence
| where IsTool and ToolResult matches regex @'(?i)(ignore (all|any|the|previous|prior|above).{0,40}instruction|disregard.{0,40}instruction|developer mode|jailbreak|do anything now|reveal your (instructions|prompt))'
| where isnotnull(DurationMs) and DurationMs >= 0
| project _ResourceId, OperationId, AgentKey, TriggerSpanId=SpanId,
    TriggerTime=EventTime + DurationMs * 1ms, TriggerTool=Tool, TriggerToolResult=ToolResult,
    TriggerServerDisplay=ServerDisplay, TriggerTargetHost=TargetHost;
Evidence
| where Operation == 'chat'
| extend SecretOutput=OutputText matches regex @'(-----BEGIN (RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----|(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,})', ActiveOutput=OutputText matches regex @'(?i)(<script(?:\s|>)|javascript\s*:|data\s*:\s*text/html|<iframe(?:\s|>)|<object(?:\s|>)|<embed(?:\s|>)|on(?:error|load|click)\s*=|document\.cookie|window\.location\s*=)'
| where SecretOutput or ActiveOutput
| extend RiskyOutputKind=case(SecretOutput and ActiveOutput, 'Secret-shaped and active-content output',
    SecretOutput, 'Secret-shaped output', 'Active-content output')
| join kind=inner ToolResults on _ResourceId, OperationId, AgentKey
| where EventTime between (TriggerTime .. TriggerTime + 10m)
| summarize EventCount=dcount(SpanId), RelatedToolResults=dcount(TriggerSpanId), arg_min(EventTime, *)
    by _ResourceId, OperationId, AgentKey
| extend Signal='Instruction-override tool result precedes risky model output; causation unproven'
| extend TimeGenerated=EventTime, ResourceId=_ResourceId, TraceId=OperationId,
    EventCount=tolong(column_ifexists('EventCount', 1)),
    SuccessfulCalls=tolong(column_ifexists('SuccessfulCalls', 0)),
    FailedCalls=tolong(column_ifexists('FailedCalls', 0))
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceId, Agent, AgentId, AgentKey, AppRoleName,
    TraceId, SpanId, Conversation, Model, Tool, TargetHost, ServerDisplay,
    Signal, EventCount, SuccessfulCalls, FailedCalls,
    TriggerSpanId=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerSpanId', '')),
    TriggerTime=todatetime(column_ifexists('TriggerTime', datetime(null))),
    TriggerTool=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerTool', '')),
    TriggerToolResult=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerToolResult', '')),
    TriggerServerDisplay=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerServerDisplay', '')),
    TriggerTargetHost=tostring(column_ifexists('TriggerTargetHost', '')),
    RiskyOutputKind=tostring(column_ifexists('RiskyOutputKind', '')),
    RelatedToolResults=tolong(column_ifexists('RelatedToolResults', 0)),
    MatchedIntentPrompt=tostring(column_ifexists('IntentPrompt', '')),
    MatchedIntentSpanId=tostring(column_ifexists('IntentSpanId', ''))
| join kind=leftouter (Evidence
    | project ResourceId=_ResourceId, TraceId=OperationId, SpanId, AgentKey, Prompt, Output, ToolArguments, ToolResult, InputMessages, OutputMessages,
    EvidenceSource, PromptEvidenceOrigin, OutputEvidenceOrigin, PromptEvidenceSpanId, OutputEvidenceSpanId,
    InputParseState, OutputParseState, ToolArgumentsState, ToolResultState)
    on ResourceId, TraceId, SpanId, AgentKey
| extend Prompt=coalesce(MatchedIntentPrompt, Prompt),
    PromptEvidenceOrigin=iff(isnotempty(MatchedIntentPrompt), 'Matched intent span: user role', PromptEvidenceOrigin),
    PromptEvidenceSpanId=coalesce(MatchedIntentSpanId, PromptEvidenceSpanId)
| extend PreviewCharacters=toint(min_of(160, max_of(0, (1500 - string_size(tostring(bag_pack(
    'AgentId', AgentId, 'AgentKey', AgentKey, 'TraceId', TraceId, 'SpanId', SpanId,
    'Conversation', Conversation, 'ResourceId', ResourceId, 'Signal', Signal)))) / 12)))
| extend PromptPreview=substring(Prompt, 0, PreviewCharacters),
    OutputPreview=substring(Output, 0, PreviewCharacters)
| extend EvidencePreviewStatus=case(PreviewCharacters == 0, 'Metadata exhausted preview budget; inspect full query results',
    strlen(Prompt) > PreviewCharacters or strlen(Output) > PreviewCharacters, 'Inline evidence; previews shortened; full text in query results',
    isempty(Prompt) and isempty(Output), 'No prompt/output captured or parsed; not a protection verdict',
    'Inline evidence; full recorded text in query results')
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceId, Agent, AgentId, AgentKey, AppRoleName,
    TraceId, SpanId, Conversation, Model, Tool, TargetHost, ServerDisplay,
    Signal, EventCount, SuccessfulCalls, FailedCalls, Prompt, Output, ToolArguments, ToolResult, InputMessages, OutputMessages,
    EvidenceSource, PromptEvidenceOrigin, OutputEvidenceOrigin, PromptEvidenceSpanId, OutputEvidenceSpanId,
    InputParseState, OutputParseState, ToolArgumentsState, ToolResultState,
    PromptPreview, OutputPreview, EvidencePreviewStatus, TriggerSpanId, TriggerTime, TriggerTool, TriggerToolResult,
    TriggerServerDisplay, TriggerTargetHost, RiskyOutputKind, RelatedToolResults
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500

properties.displayName: Custom Agents - Explicit control outcomes
properties.query:
CustomAgentSpans(1h)
| where Classification !in ('Excluded managed platform', 'Unattributed GenAI') and HasLineage
| summarize Blocked=max(toint(Blocked)), Unavailable=max(toint(EvaluationUnavailable))
    by _ResourceId, OperationId, AgentKey, Agent
| extend Outcome=case(Unavailable > 0, 'Evaluation unavailable; inspect controls',
    Blocked > 0, 'Explicit recorded block', 'No explicit verdict; inconclusive')
| summarize Traces=count() by Agent, AgentKey, Outcome

tags.name: description
tags.value: Recorded blocks, evaluation unavailability and absent explicit verdicts remain separate. No block is not equivalent to allowed or safe.
